# Briefing Checklist

> Template: §20.5 — Core+ with framing required

- [ ] Problem / opportunity clearly stated
- [ ] Winning subject identified
- [ ] Who pays the cost of failure identified
- [ ] Expected outcome stated
- [ ] Success signal defined
- [ ] Failure condition defined
- [ ] What must not break listed
- [ ] Scope bounded
- [ ] Assumptions listed
- [ ] CJM / Product Flow Delta need assessed
- [ ] Six Hats Review mode decided (full/shortened)
- [ ] Documentation update requirements after release identified
